components.gap: The packet's framing chapter states the 1954 attraction definition with "A_n real and B_n real and nonzero" (w02c-p15-016 lines 71-93, explicitly lines 83-84) and its boundary asserts that "the normal case" of Section 35 is proved in the handbook (lines 229-232), presenting Theorem 1 as the normal case of thm:p15-nda-characterization (lines 112-129). The characterization (normal-domains-of-attraction.tex lines 180-201; annex 637-684), the symmetric-necessity theorem (lines 150-167) and the cutoff interface use only positive scales d_n, b_n, B_n > 0, and the types lemma (w02c-p15-016 lines 95-101; annex 6-40) only positive a. The case the stated definition admits, (1/B_n)S_n - A_n => N(m,v) with B_n < 0 for some (possibly infinitely many) n, is never reduced to a positive-scale normalization (by the reflection symmetry of the normal type), so the necessity half of Theorem 1 as the handbook itself states the definition is not fully written. Either restrict the reported definition to positive B_n or add the sign-reduction step.
